resources.string: When you\'re near a designated work location, we can clock you in automatically. When you leave, we\'ll clock you out. This helps ensure your hours are recorded accurately.

Auto clock-in works best when the app can check your location in the background. With “While Using the App” access, we can only detect your work location while the app is open, so clock-ins may be missed or delayed. To turn this on, choose “Allow all the time” in Settings.
Limited location access: auto clock-in only works while the app is open.
